title: Archiving the Now
summary: Created as part of the Archiving the Now exhibition at Sikka Art & Design Festival 2024, commissioned by Dubai Culture.
description:
Created as part of the Archiving the Now exhibition at Sikka Art & Design Festival 2024, commissioned by Dubai Culture.

This documentary video explores the 40-year photographic journey of Mohammad Ahmad Bin Hashem, documenting key moments in the history of the UAE.

I handled the cinematography and editing, shaping archival material and interview-based content into a cohesive documentary narrative.
